notes.title: 1.3.11 (8 players online)
notes.notes: Now you can play with seven players online! In multiplayer, the nicknames of the players became visible next to the health bar. 4 more different colors were also added to distinguish between 8 tanks.

notes.title: 1.3.10 (List of players)
notes.notes:
Hello people! Another update! In this update, the system of adding and removing players in multiplayer has been completely changed. Bugs related to the player's exit have been fixed.

Now, when you open the chat, you will see a list of players.

A few minor changes:
[list]
[*] the ping of the players is shown
[*] removed the 4x4 map size
[*] you can kick player during the game
[/list]

Now you can change the maximum number of players when creating a lobby. So far, no more than 4, but it is planned to make 8 people!

notes.title: 1.3.9 (3D vs AI)
notes.notes:
As you remember, it was possible to fight against AI only in 2D mode. Now you can also play in 3D mode. It's much more interesting, but sometimes very difficult.
Now the size of the map depends on the number of players (it will not be 4x4 size with three or four players).
Also, I optimized the flight of bullets in multiplayer.

notes.title: 1.3.8 (Chat)
notes.notes: Here's another update! Now you can write messages to each other while you play! If you want to turn off the chat, you can go to options -> game. Fixed a bug where the player's nickname was not visible when entering the game. Now in the options you can see the interface management (how to open a chat, how to open a pause, etc.). Also in the near future it is planned to add new bonuses and make a 3D mode against the bot.

The placement of tanks at the beginning of the game has been changed, now the tanks will spawn away from each other (at the beginning of the game, the field is divided into 4 equal parts and a tank will spawn in each). In multiplayer and single vs AI modes, you can shoot using the mouse. Changed the control of the rocket in single player mode for the third player. Fixed a bug in multiplayer mode when a pause window appears, previously it was possible to continue playing during a pause.

notes.title: 1.3.6 (Release)
notes.notes: Now you can set up the maximum score before the start of the game and after the end of the game it will be shown who won! Multiplayer: added a "Kick" button to kick a player out of the Lobby; fixed a bug where the lobby remained after all players left. Control: control interface has changed and the mouse control has been improved, now it is more convenient. New music and sounds have also been added.

notes.title: Full release is coming soon
notes.notes: On February 3rd we are planning to release a big update! On the same day, the game will switch from early access to a full release, because we have achieved what we planned for release. And then we will make the game free. Those who bought the game before February 3 - in the future you will receive nice bonuses!

notes.title: 1.3.5 (Artificial intelligence)
notes.notes: In this update, the AI has been improved, now it has several behaviors, between which it competently switches! Also, the interface in the singleplayer game was changed when choosing the mode, a bug in the options was fixed when the control in 3D mode was not shown. Added an individual panel in the main menu with a nickname and avatar, in the future there will be a player rating.

notes.title: 1.3.4 (Simple AI)
notes.notes: A simple AI has appeared in this update, it's not so interesting to play with him yet, but I posted it so you can test it. I also started adding statistics (it are not visible to you yet), later they can be used to get a rating of players. In the future, the rating will affect the player's search in multiplayer.

notes.title: 1.3.3 (Optimization)
notes.notes: I optimized the 2d mode, previously the camera from 3d mode continued to work there, which was very expensive. Also fix a few small bugs.

notes.title: 1.3.2 (Random size of labyrinth)
notes.notes:
In 3 months I made a random size of the maze, there are 5 variants: 4x4, 4x6, 6x6, 6x8, 8x8.
In previous versions there were a lot of bugs with bullets, now all the bugs are fixed (the ones I found).
I didn't like that in multiplayer it was impossible to connect during the game, only in Lobby, but now you can connect (and they can connect to you) during the game.
I changed the appearance of the walls, they are now rounded at the edges.
The design of the score panel has changed, there is now a bonus visible next to the player.
Fix bug with rocket in multiplayer 3D (when you stop controlling the rocket, the camera is not destroyed).

notes.title: 1.3.0 (3D Multiplayer)
notes.notes:
Another big update! The most important thing in this update is that there is a 3D mode in multiplayer. I also optimized the light in the game very much, the quality has not changed much, but now the game has started to work much faster. I also changed the interface in multiplayer, now everything looks very nice! Naturally, I fixed a few minor bugs:) I hope you enjoy the update! In the next update there will be a rating in multiplayer, but it will only be in the summer.

Good luck to everyone! Do not forget to write reviews, I will be very pleased:))
Changed the algorithm for set-up of the wall; add text of version; now tanks are spawned with a random rotation in multiplayer.
Fix bugs in singleplayer
Fix bug with rocket and with machinegun.
Fix bug with bonus "machinegun".
Change color for nickname in multiplayer and add text "Waiting for more players..." in multiplayer when players < 2.
Fix bug with portal and rocket.
Fix some bugs in multiplayer.
Change color in 3D mode; fix bugs with volume; change button "Ready" in lobby.
Fix bugs with FPS.

notes.title: 1.2.0 (Multiplayer)
notes.notes: I finally did it! It's been six months since the last update. During this time I have done a lot. I added beautiful music, added sound for almost every bonus and made a new Teleport bonus, localized the game into 4 languages. Almost all bonuses have slightly changed mechanics. Also, I have redesigned the menu interface, now there is a description of each bonus. But the most important thing is that I added multiplayer, and now anyone can play online with someone (the maximum number of players is 4).
The maze generation has been changed; some bugs with the "Wall" bonus have been fixed; the score indicator has been moved.
Fixing bugs with a small screen resolution. Fixing a bug when a rocket is fired.
Fixed bugs. Optimization.
Returning to the old version, due to a large number of bugs in the new version.
Removed the window when entering the game. Optimization.
We fixed a lot of bugs.
